description_en: Queries or searches for a list of events
description_zh: 调用ListTopics获取或搜索事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-topics --begin-time 2019-03-24T00:00:00+0800 --end-time 2019-03-25T23:00:00+0800 --topic-types ERROR,SLOW --topic-statuses IGNORE,NEW,FIXING,RECOVER --node-id 1234 --instance-id 12345 --owner 9527950000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTopics

parameters.help_en: The start time for discovery. Specify the time in UTC format (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)
parameters.help_zh: 起始发现时间，需要使用UTC格式（yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ）
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for discovery. Specify the time in UTC format (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)
parameters.help_zh: 截止发现时间，需要使用UTC格式（yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The type of the event. Valid values: SLOW (slow) and ERROR (error). Separate multiple event types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 事件的类型，包括SLOW（变慢）和ERROR（出错）。多个事件类型之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: topic_types

parameters.help_en: The status of the event. Valid values: IGNORE (ignored), NEW (newly discovered), FIXING (being processed), and RECOVER (recovered). Separate multiple event statuses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 事件的状态，包括IGNORE（已忽略）、NEW（新发现）、FIXING（处理中）和RECOVER（已恢复）。多个事件状态之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: topic_statuses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node associated with the event. This parameter is mutually exclusive with InstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 事件关联的任务节点ID，与参数InstanceId互斥
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID associated with the event. This parameter is mutually exclusive with NodeId
parameters.help_zh: 事件关联的实例ID，与参数NodeId互斥
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the event owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 分页的页数。默认值为1，最小值为1，最大值为30
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
